_comment: Starter evaluation suite — structural assertions over a compiled Effective Agent Spec, graded deterministically before any agent runs on the candidate (C-4). Seed content: a deployment owns its own suites, and these are the cases that generalise. Every case here corresponds to a defect this platform actually shipped.

cases.describe: the cortex soul is in the bundle at all
the rendered cortex soul fits the runtime's 40,000-character cap, which truncates silently

the role overlay's provenance marker appears exactly once. This is the case that would have caught the soul-doubling defect: a `contains` check passed the whole time the overlay was landing twice, because it WAS there — twice. millie reached 7 copies and a 28KB soul before anything noticed.

no organ still instructs the follow_process action, deleted at v2026.08.14.6.15. A prompt naming an action the daemon no longer accepts wastes an iteration and reads to the model as a capability it has.
organ layer purity (C-28) — tool invocations belong in skills, not souls. A backticked command-with-flag in a soul is the shape that rots when the tool changes.
